thread:
Alex Chen: quick sync — planning to ship v2.18 canary tomorrow AM. proposing we tighten the latency tolerance for the runtime path change. current gate uses p99 < 260ms; I want to nominate p99 < 230ms, p95 < 120ms, error rate < 0.3% as the canary thresholds. thoughts? :thinking:

Maria Lopez: do we have the most recent perf run from the staging cluster? last run looked noisy because of a background batch job. :grimacing:

Alex Chen: infra job was disabled last night, ran a clean bench this morning. attaching quick summary below.

Maria Lopez: nice, paste the numbers?

Alex Chen: ```
// staging-perf-2026-02-28
route: /v1/generate
load: 250 rps (synthetic mix)
samples: 6000 requests
p50: 45ms
p95: 115ms
p99: 218ms
errors: 0.12% (mostly 429s during short burst)
cpu/gpu util: stable
NOTE: KV cache warm during run
```

Corey Patel: p99 218ms looks ok but 429s are concerning — what caused bursts? we need deterministic repro for rollout. Also, we should add a rolling window rule: fail canary if p99 > 300ms for 3 consecutive 1-min windows OR errors > 0.5% sustained for 2 mins.

Samira Ng: who signs off on the tighter thresholds? last time PM asked for more room. @maria any objections from product regarding latency/quality tradeoff?

Maria Lopez: product is ok tightening if we can keep errors below 0.5%. They want smoke-by-smoke checks on generation quality too (small eval set). I'll run a quick eval after canary starts.

Infra Bot: perf-check completed: https://perf.redwood/internal/runs/67321 — baseline comparison attached. (automated note) :robot_face:

Alex Chen: thanks. action items: 1) infra to pin staging job schedule and run one more bench tonight (corey + infra) 2) eng-runtime to add check in rollout policy: p99 threshold = 230ms, p95 = 120ms, errors < 0.3% and the rollback rule Corey suggested 3) maria to run smoke eval during canary 4) samira to provide final approval by 09:00 PT tomorrow. I'll start canary only after all green.

Corey Patel: I'll add the rollout policy snippet to the PR now. snippet: ```
rollout_gate:
  metrics:
    - name: latency_p99
      threshold: 230
      window: 60s
      consecutive_failures: 3
    - name: error_rate
      threshold: 0.3
      window: 60s
      sustained_minutes: 2
  action: rollback
```

Samira Ng: noted. i can approve once maria posts smoke eval and infra confirms the bench tonight. tagging @alex for final readiness. :eyes:

Maria Lopez: i'll schedule the eval during canary and paste results here. planning small set of 20 prompts, checking hallucination and token usage.

Alex Chen: perfect. if all go green i'll trigger the canary at 09:30 PT and monitor the first 30 minutes closely. fallback plan: automatic rollback + switch to v2.17 variant; manual escalation to oncall if metrics keep degrading. :thumbsup:

Infra Bot: staging bench scheduled at 23:00 PT, results will post to this thread. (automated note)

Corey Patel: PR link: https://repo.redwood/dev/rollouts/pulls/482 — added gate, tests, and a short runbook entry for rollback steps.

Alex Chen: thanks all — plan stands unless objections. Samira, please confirm approval by 09:00 PT tomorrow.

Samira Ng: approved. go ahead if infra bench is clean and maria's eval is green. :white_check_mark:

Alex Chen: moving forward then. I'll post a canary start message and brief live metrics link when I flip the rollout. 

Maria Lopez: eval completed during canary start — initial results: 20/20 prompts passed quality heuristics, avg tokens 142, no spike in hallucination score. posting full results link: https://evals.redwood/internal/2001

Alex Chen: canary started at 09:32 PT. live dashboard: https://console.redwood/canary/3245 — monitoring now.

Infra Bot: alert: short p95 blip at 09:36 PT to 160ms, p99 remained under 240ms, no rollbacks triggered. (automated)

Alex Chen: kept an eye, blip subsided, continuing. will call rollback if p99 crosses 300ms or errors >0.5% for thresholds in policy.

Corey Patel: saw the blip on flamegraph — tracing suggests a rare scheduler contention on one host. filed infra ticket: INF-9982. recommend eviction/restart if it recurs.

Alex Chen: nice catch. if it recurs we pull the node. otherwise marking this canary as APPROVED after 45m of stable metrics. final note: we learned to tighten p99 to 230ms safely for this path.

Samira Ng: thanks team — good green signal. :rocket:
